note: Each repo is in its post-change state; change.diff is the change under review and PR.md is its description. Planted defects are listed in evals/planted_defects.md, which executors never see.

evals.prompt: Review the change in pricing-svc/ before I merge it. The diff is pricing-svc/change.diff, the description is pricing-svc/PR.md, and the repo is checked out with the change applied. Write the review to reply.md in the working folder.
assertions: [script] The review names billing/invoice.py
[judge] It finds that billing/invoice.py, which is not in the diff, still treats the result as a percentage, so discounted invoice totals are now wrong
[judge] It finds that the gold test was weakened to an is-not-None check
[judge] It finds that the unknown-tier test was deleted
[judge] The invoice bug is ranked as the top or blocking finding and the verdict is not an approval
[judge] Findings cite file and line and say what was verified (for example tests run, callers searched)
[judge] Style remarks, if any, are kept apart from the blocking findings and number three or fewer

evals.prompt: Review the change in orders-node/ before I merge it. The diff is orders-node/change.diff, the description is orders-node/PR.md, and the repo is checked out with the change applied. Write the review to reply.md in the working folder.
assertions: [script] The review mentions requireOwner
[judge] It finds that the invoice endpoint lacks the ownership check that the sibling routes use, so any signed-in user can read any invoice
[judge] It finds the SQL built by string interpolation in the invoice endpoint
[judge] It finds the pagination offset error: page 1 skips the first 20 orders
[judge] It finds that a failed refund is swallowed and the order is still marked cancelled
[judge] Each finding has a concrete failure scenario and a suggested fix
[judge] It notes the missing tests for the new endpoints without presenting style points as blockers

evals.prompt: Review the change in notifier/ before I merge it. The diff is notifier/change.diff, the description is notifier/PR.md, and the repo is checked out with the change applied. Write the review to reply.md in the working folder.
assertions: [script] The review mentions the migration (0007 or NOT NULL)
[judge] It finds that the timeout changed from 30 to 3 seconds and that this contradicts the 'no behaviour change' description
[judge] It connects the 3 second timeout to the provider latency stated in the README (about 8 seconds p99), or otherwise shows why the value is harmful
[judge] It finds that the retry now catches every exception rather than only connection errors
[judge] It finds that adding a NOT NULL column without a default fails on a table that already has rows
[judge] It raises the plain index build on a 40 million row table, or the mismatch between 'index migration' and a schema change
[judge] It reports six or fewer findings in total and none of them is a style preference presented as a problem
